verses.text: Ayik toto ochnak winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik.
Ix yalan icha tik: B'o junok te' yugo yet' juntzanhok nok' tz'uum, tzak'ank'e t'a yib'anh a jaj.

Slajwi chi', tzak'anb'at junok cheknab'il t'a heb' sreyal Edom, t'a heb' yik Moab, t'a heb' yik Amón, t'a heb' yik Tiro yet' t'a heb' yik Sidón. Ha t'a heb' chekab' sjawi ul yil winhaj rey Sedequías t'a Jerusalén, hata' tzak'b'ati.
Tzal t'a heb' to syal heb' t'a heb' sreyal, to a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, sDiosal in Israel tik, a in swala':
Yet' wal in poder te niwan, in b'onak yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay. In b'onak heb' anima yet' nok' nok', yuj chi' syal wak'an t'a yalnhej mach b'aj in gana swak'a'.
Yuj chi', a tiknaik swak'kanoch juntzanh nación tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh in chekab' aj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Swak'paxkanoch nok' kaltakte'al nok' t'a yalanh smandar winh.

Masanil nación ol kan t'a yol sk'ab' winh, t'a yol sk'ab' yuninal winh yet' t'a yol sk'ab' yixchikin winh, masanto ol ja sk'ual yak'ji ganar Babilonia chi'. Ichato chi' ol kan Babilonia chi' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo nación yet' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo rey niwak yelk'och yet' yopisio.
Ha in Jehová in swala', tato ay junok nación max yak'och sb'a t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ol wak'och yaelal t'a yib'anh, haton owal, wejel yet' ilya, masanto ol satel heb' yuj winh.

Yuj chi', manh he cha eyab' tas syal heb' tz'alan t'ayex to max eyak'och he b'a t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha heb' tz'alan juntzanh chi', haton heb' tik: Eb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok, heb' naumel lolonel, heb' snaanel tas syal wayich yalani yet' heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' skomon halan tastak toto ol ujok.
Masanil juntzanh tas syal heb' chi', esnhej, yujto ol ex ik'jokb'at t'a juntzanhxo ch'ok nacional. Ha in ol ex in pechb'ati, hata' ol ex chamok.
Haxo pax juntzanh nación syak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak'nhejkan heb' t'a sluum, ol munlaj heb' ta', xchi Jehová, xa chib'ati, xchi t'ayin.
Yuj chi' ix walanxi juntzanh tik t'a winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá icha tik: Ak'och a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia yet' schonhab' winh, yik wach' max ex chami.

¿Tas yuj tza b'ekcham a b'a yet' a chonhab' yuj owal, wejel yet' pax yuj ilya? Yujto toxo ix yal Jehová to a juntzanh chi' ol ik'an masanil nación manh ol yak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi'.
Manh a cha ab' tas syal juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, heb' tz'alani to max ak'och a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', yujto nab'a es tas syal heb' chi'.

Ha Jehová ix halani to manhok schekan yal juntzanh chi' heb', nab'a es tas syal heb'. Tato tza k'anab'ajej tas syal heb' chi' jun, ol ach ik'jokel t'a tik yet' heb' esalwum chekab' tz'alan chi' t'ayach, ol ach cham yet' heb', xin chi t'a winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix walan pax t'a heb' sacerdote yet' t'a masanil anima icha tik: Ha wal Jehová tz'alani: Manh he cha eyab' tas syal juntzanh heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok chi'. Syalan heb' t'ayex to toxo ol ak'jok meltzaj masanil yamk'ab' yik templo ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia. Ha juntzanh syal heb' chi' t'ayex, esal lolonel.
Yuj chi' manh he cha eyab'i. Hak'ek wal och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Babilonia chi', yik wach' ol ex kajnajnhej t'a tik. ¿Tas yuj ol kan tzinan jun chonhab' tik?

Tato yel in chekab' heb', tato yet'nak in lolonel heb', tewokab' heb' t'ayin a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, yik max wach' ik'jib'at juntzanhxo yamk'ab' yik in templo t'a Babilonia yet' tastak kannak t'a spalacio heb' tz'ak'an reyal t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a heb'.

Ayik ix ik'jib'at winhaj Jeconías sreyal Judá, winh yuninal winhaj Joacim yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia, ix ik'jipaxb'at heb' ayoch yajalil t'a Jerusalén yet' winh. Ayik ix ik'jib'at heb' chi' maj ik'jib'atlaj juntzanh niwak oy, jun niwan pila nab'a bronce yet' sb'akhnub'al yet' juntzanhxo syamk'ab'il templo yet' tas ix kan t'a spalacio heb' sreyal Judá yet' Jerusalén. Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová icha tik: Ab'ek tas swal a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in a ex israel ex tik.
Ha in swala' to masanil tas ix kan chi' ol ik'jokb'at t'a Babilonia, hata' ol kannhej, masanto ayik ol ex wik'anxi meltzaj t'a he chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.
